messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: INC-2026 fired for service=redwood-inference-api route=/v1/generate severity=page reason= p99_latency > 3.5s (10m) - link: https://pd.example/INC-2026

sara.lee: acked INC-2026 :hand: I'm oncall, looking at p99 spike for eu-west.

mike: seeing the spike too on dashboards, p95 up 2.1s, p99 4.1s. No error-rate increase.

lee: any recent deploys?

ops-bot: deploy-bot posted: deploy/2026-redwood-runtime v2.14 promoted to eu-west at 2024-11-04T02:18Z

sara.lee: nope I didn't trigger a deploy. checking rollout history and model routing.

mike: grep from sidecar logs: `kubectl logs -l app=sidecar -n inference | jq '.latency' | tail -n 200` shows occasional 5-6s tails pinned to hotkey traffic. attaching sample: `hotkey=nlp-hot-42, backend=gpupool-3, reqs=120`

lee: could be KV cache thrash or a hotkey causing oversized batches. Any k/v evictions?

ops-bot: metrics: redis.evictions increased +48% in last 6m for eu-west-kv.

sara.lee: ok that's consistent. mitigation plan: 1) divert route /v1/generate to fallback smaller-model variant; 2) bump dedicated pool autoscale to +20% for eu-west; 3) warm KV cache for hotkey. doing step 1 now.

mike: how to divert? runbook has `routeset fallback --route generate --model gf-small --annotate incident=INC-2026`

sara.lee: running command in prod: `routeset fallback --route /v1/generate --model gpt-medium-quant --reason INC-2026`

incident-bot: routeset change applied by sara.lee at 2024-11-04T02:25Z - route /v1/generate -> gpt-medium-quant (fallback)

mike: dashboards showing p99 -> 2.7s within 2m of switch. p95 -> 1.4s. improvement but still above target 1.2s.

lee: warming cache for hotkey: `kv-client prewarm --key nlphot42 --region eu-west --count 500`

ops-bot: prewarm job queued (job-id=prewarm-778).

oncall-backup: I'm available if you want me to start scaling nodes manually, sara.lee.

sara.lee: thanks, please stand by, might need manual scale if autoscaler lags. Chris? (cc @oncall-backup)

mike: autoscaler reacted, +2 instances in gpupool-3 at 02:28Z. watching for regression.

sara.lee: quick customer check: no elevated 5xx in monitoring, only client-side latency. notify support?

lee: create a short blurb: "We briefly observed elevated generation latency in EU-WEST; routing fallback applied and autoscale triggered. No errors or data loss. Engineers are monitoring."

mike: note for postmortem: root cause likely KV eviction loop + concentrated hotkey. consider sticky routing or cache partitioning.

sara.lee: will keep thread open. if p99 stays <3s for 15m we can clear. setting status: investigating -> mitigated (temporary).

incident-bot: INC-2026 status updated -> mitigated by sara.lee at 2024-11-04T02:33Z

mike: p99 1.9s now, p95 1.1s. good.

sara.lee: holding for 20 more minutes, will hand off to oncall-backup for rotation at 02:55Z if stable. adding runbook note: `cache-thrash-hotkey` and recommending cooldown experiment.

oncall-backup: ack, will take over rotation if needed. ping me for handoff.

lee: short post-incident todo: 1) add automated hotkey detection to alert thresholds, 2) add fallback route test to canary, 3) investigate eviction causes with infra.

sara.lee: thanks team. closing live mitigation. will open postmortem ticket for INC-2026 with timeline and checklist. :thumbsup:"
